name: Witch Bolt
description: A beam of crackling, blue energy lances out toward a creature within range, forming a sustained arc of lightning between you and the target. Ranged spell attack; on hit, 1d12 lightning damage, and on each of your turns you can use your action to deal another 1d12 lightning damage.
